quotes.text:
Hey HN,

I recently published a simple Android app, Tech Terms Quiz. It’s a straightforward quiz game where you see an abbreviation (like "CPU") and try to guess its full form. No ads, —just a simple game for testing your IT knowledge.

I built this as a learning project, so it’s not super polished, but I’d love feedback from the community. If you’re into tech and enjoy quizzes, give it a try!

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.nispeteng.ttq

Would love to hear your thoughts and any feature suggestions!
